messages.subject: Scanone VS Scantwo
parts:
Hello dear Karl
I have a problem with results of scanone and scantwo.
I have provided scanone with two methods ("em" and "hk" 1000 imputation). 
Threshold estimation for "em" and "hk"
5%    4.00
1%    4.81

Than I got 4 Qtls for "em" and three for "hk" method

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Scanone VS Scantwo
parts:
It's not really a matter of reliability. scanone() fits a single-QTL model at each position, while scantwo() fits a two-QTL model. The estimated location of QTL may depend on whether you're including other QTL in the model.

karl
